query:
Two family members made essentially the same observation about Emeka needing rest after a demanding day — one grounding it in shared experience, the other in clinical reasoning. Who made the shared-experience framing, and what specifically distinguishes their message from the other person's?

Options:
A. Tolu
B. Auntie Grace
C. Adaeze
D. Uncle Dele
context:
[1] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:36:00) Clinically speaking, rest after exertion is appropriate. Just to note, Dad - if this is a pattern we should talk.
[2] (about=Seun, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:29:00) honestly Dad you should rest though I mean you were on your feet most of yesterday
[3] (about=Adaeze, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Confirms Sunday call happened; Emeka was on briefly and said he needed to rest.
[4] (about=Adaeze, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Reassures that Emeka is fine, just resting; thanks everyone for the gathering.
[5] (about=Auntie Grace, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Advises Emeka to listen to Tolu; sees too many patients who push through; a missed Sunday is fine, just rest.
[6] (about=Auntie Grace, said_by=Emeka, profile, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Emeka says good.
[7] (about=Emeka, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Confirms he was tired.
[8] (about=Emeka, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Acknowledges advice with 'Noted.'
[9] (about=Kayode, said_by=Emeka, profile, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Emeka says 'Good work.'
[10] (about=Funke, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:32:00) EMEKA 💀 said what he said 😂
[11] (about=Kayode, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Thought Emeka was tired from yesterday.
[12] (about=Nkem, said_by=Emeka, profile, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Emeka says she came, that is what matters.
[13] (about=Seun, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Advises Emeka to rest; notes he was on his feet most of yesterday.
[14] (about=Seun, said_by=Emeka, profile, t4 @2025-01-20T20:02:00) Emeka acknowledges Seun's knowledge with 'She knows. She has always known.'
[15] (about=Tolu, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Notes that Emeka missed church this morning; asks if others noticed.
[16] (about=Tolu, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Clinically, rest after exertion is appropriate; if this is a pattern, they should talk.
[17] (about=Uncle Dele, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Acknowledges Emeka's tiredness; emphasizes rest is important at their age.
[18] (about=Uncle Dele, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Agrees with Tolu that rest is appropriate; Emeka has always been disciplined about his health; nothing to concern.
agent_answer:
B. Auntie Grace

Auntie Grace grounded her advice in **shared experience** by citing what she had personally observed: *“I see too many patients who push through when they should be resting.”* This appeals to accumulated real-world cases rather than formal reasoning.  

Tolu, by contrast, used **clinical reasoning**: *“Clinically speaking, rest after exertion is appropriate,”* and added a conditional diagnostic note: *“if this is a pattern we should talk.”*  

The key distinction is that Auntie Grace justified rest through her first-hand professional observations, while Tolu justified it through clinical principle.
